source: V20 Dark Ages (VtDA20), pp. 188-316. Codes and short summaries; read the page for the full system.

abyss.ritual: Occult 3+, level capped by Obtenebration or Occult; +1 difficulty without an Occult specialty (p. 270)

lesser.Thaumaturgy: Creatio Ignis: one success reaches 10 yards, each more adds 10; Perception + Alertness to hit. A botch spills the flame or burns the caster.
lesser.Thaumaturgy: Iter Pernix: each success is an hour on the road at about 45 km/h with no fatigue; no effect in combat. A botch makes mounts balk (half speed or off course).
lesser.Thaumaturgy: Potestas Motus: a turn of control per success, renewed with another roll; five successes hold it for the scene. A botch roots the caster's feet for a turn (no dodging).
lesser.Thaumaturgy: Potestas Tempestatum: successes set how fast it comes (one is a day's drift, five is at once); a scene per success; +2 difficulty indoors, where only fog, wind and temperature work. A botch angers local spirits.
lesser.note: A lesser path grows one power's force with each dot, not new powers (VtDA20 p. 297).

dark.power: b1, Willpower at level + 3; a botch costs a permanent Willpower point (DAC 2002 p. 105)
dark.maleficia: A target who knows they are afflicted and faces the infernalist may roll Wits + Occult at the infernalist's Willpower to turn it back; a botch turns it on the caster; the Church's exorcism or blessing lifts a curse; all end if the infernalist dies (DAC 2002 p. 109)
dark.manes: Rego Manes also wounds any spirit at once with a few words: roll the path rating as damage, resisted by Willpower. A called demon stays until sunrise or church bells (DAC 2002 pp. 107-108).

powers.e: Senses predators nearby (Cainites, shapeshifters, ghosts, killers) for the scene.
One turn to grow a predator's trait: claws (Strength +1 lethal), a tail, keen senses and the like.
Sinks into a sleep just short of torpor, hidden from senses and Auspex.
Takes on a darkness-born trait for the scene; Rötschreck is +1 difficulty meanwhile.
Becomes a chosen predator animal; the form must be learned in advance.
Speaks with an animal after eye contact; no roll.
Calls animals of a named kind; more successes, more come.
Cows or soothes a creature's Beast; a mortal loses Willpower drive, a vampire can't frenzy for the scene.
Possesses an animal after eye contact; mental Disciplines work through it as successes allow.
Forces their Beast into another after eye contact: frenzy or worse in the target, calm in themself.
Sharpens a sense: its rolls are at −Auspex difficulty. Sudden glare or noise can stun.
Reads a subject's aura: mood, then nature of being (vampire, mage...) with more successes.
Reads impressions from a touched object; older, weaker traces are harder (4 to 9).
Sends or reads thoughts; one success to send, more to read deeper.
Projects the mind out of the body, travelling invisibly; the body lies helpless.
Within a week of losing a Humanity dot, rolls to regain it without experience.
A mystic 'dodge': successes cancel a supernatural attack's successes.
Animal blood nourishes fully; an animal holds blood equal to its health levels.
A night-long rite consecrates a place where violence and frenzy are hard.
Speaks words that strip a listener of their Beast's influence for the scene.
A stationary illusion of one sense, about 7 cubic metres per dot.
An illusion for all senses, still or moving as chosen at creation.
Animates an existing illusion while the vampire concentrates.
An illusion lasts until dismissed.
An illusion one victim believes real: it can hurt them (lethal levels by successes).
Learns a subject's moral weakness or Virtue shortfall.
Mocking a known fear makes the target flee or freeze; vampires test Rötschreck.
Hurls a bolt of infernal flame: aggravated damage.
After Sense the Sin, the target rolls their lowest Virtue (vs the Baali's Willpower) or their derangements erupt.
A lasting curse; successes set its length (a week up to permanent).
Inflames one emotion in the target; successes extend it.
After three turns of talk, the victim is plagued by sights and sounds for nights by successes.
Reads the hidden pattern in a person, court or event.
A stronger Soul Haunting that can drive one or several into madness for the scene.
Strips a target's sanity, granting a temporary derangement.
A one-word command, obeyed at once after eye contact.
Implants a complex instruction; successes set how well it holds.
Removes or rewrites memories; more successes, deeper changes.
Extended: 5 to 10 × the subject's Self-Control/Instinct successes make them pliant.
After a clash of wills (subject rolls Willpower, 7), takes over a mortal's body.
Knows when someone deliberately lies; no roll.
Sees fae and the fae-touched truly, and senses faerie magic.
Absorbs an object's impressions, erasing them as they are learned.
A ward symbol that bars or hurts a named fae, object or person.
Poses a riddle the victim can do nothing but ponder until solved.
A zone of total silence around them, up to 20 feet.
Unnoticed while still and quiet; drawing attention breaks it.
Seen as someone else; copying a real face needs a good look.
Disappears even while watched; contested by the highest Wits + Alertness.
Extends an Obfuscate power to one more person per dot of Stealth.
+1 die to Intimidation and Stealth; shapes nearby shadows.
A 10-foot cloud of utter darkness; those inside fight blind and may falter.
One 6-foot shadow tentacle per success that grapples and crushes.
Shadow images, one per success, or one larger one.
Three turns to become living shadow: immune to most physical harm, can't touch or be touched.
A sacrificial rite seeds an area with slumbering plants that hinder intruders (−2 to all pools).
A sacrificed warrior's head gives them wound immunity and fighting edges for a scene.
A curse laid through the sacrifice of the target's friend or kin.
A wicker-man rite over three nights; a great blessing of war.
A sacrifice on a dolmen opens a draught of power and blood.
Projects one simple impression to everyone around: social rolls helped.
Terrifies a target: cowed, fleeing or frozen by successes.
Bends a subject's emotions: they want to serve the vampire, from hours to months by successes.
Calls someone the vampire has met to come to them, as fast and as willingly as successes allow.
No roll: anyone who would act against them rolls Courage (vs their Charisma + Intimidation) or can't.
Sees in darkness; ignores blind-fighting penalties; eyes glow red.
Claws: Strength +1 aggravated damage.
Sinks into bare earth and rests there, safe from the sun.
Becomes a wolf or bat over three turns (extra blood speeds it).
Becomes mist over three turns; immune to most physical harm.
Drains a victim nearly dry to learn and keep the gist of their knowledge.
Turns blood to poison (up to the per-turn limit); a hit reduces Stamina by successes.
After their blood enters the target, wracks them from afar: lethal damage by successes.
Blood on a blade or claws as poison: aggravated wounds.
After feeding on mortal blood, each success makes a point count double.
Hardens or preserves an object with their blood.
With a point of the target's blood in a vessel, knows when they lie.
A blood baptism that can wash away a blood bond or Dominate.
Imprints an emotion in a subject's blood; whoever drinks it feels it.
Through a drop of the target's vitae, makes them sweat blood points away.
−1 difficulty on Social rolls; a gaze can freeze one target in place.
A forked tongue lash: Strength aggravated damage, an extra attack.
Scaled skin: soak difficulty 5, Stamina soaks aggravated (not fire or sun).
Becomes a great serpent over three turns (blood speeds it).
Births a serpent-beast from their own flesh; a health level stays marked while it lives.
Bargains with an object's spirit for bonus dice on one kind of task.
A spirit animal takes form; successes set how long it stays.
Takes on one animal trait for a turn per success.
Devours a spirit: a Willpower point per success.
Strength +3, Dexterity and Stamina +2; Appearance and Manipulation fall.
Knows the exact time and how long has passed.
Reflexively freezes a moment to think: extra time to plan or defend.
Slows a target's actions; harder against faster beings.
Leaden Movement on several targets (a blood point each).
Extra actions in a turn by successes, ignoring the blood limit.
Reads health, wounds, blood and whether a subject is living or undead.
A touch blocks pain (wound penalties ignored) or puts someone to sleep.
Heals a touched creature: a blood point per lethal level, two per aggravated.
A barrier of force around them and those they shield.
Cleanses a soul of derangement or the Beast's weight; can restore Road.
Like Sense Vitality, but for death and the dead.
Like Gift of Sleep: dulls their own wound penalties or knocks a foe out.
A grasp that burns: aggravated damage per blood point.
Armor 1 per success (up to five), glowing red.
A hand over the heart kills peacefully; costly for their Road.
Senses a person or event that will matter to their fate.
A touched foe is +2 difficulty to strike them for three turns.
Smeared blood makes the victim shunned by all.
An aura in one chamber where violence falters.
Draws out a victim's soul with a breath.
Reshapes their own face and body (a blood point per change).
Reshapes another's flesh after subduing them.
Reshapes bone; as an attack, aggravated damage.
War-form: Physical Attributes +3, Social 0, claws.
Gives a severed part of their body a life of its own.
Gazes into a ball of shadow to scry the Abyss.
Crushing a flame (an aggravated level, a Rötschreck test), sees through darkness.
Draws the Abyss into their flesh after a turn of meditation.
A night-long summoning of a shade from the Abyss.

Glides: drifts safely down from any height, and a strong wind can carry it far; more than about 1 kg of load drops it.
Flies at up to 45 km/h with up to 10 kg; anything but a straight line takes Dexterity + Athletics, and Dodge loses two dice in the air.
Flies at up to 60 km/h with up to 25 kg (if Strength allows); only the hardest moves need a roll (difficulty 5), and Dodge is whole.
Flies at up to 90 km/h with up to 50 kg (if Strength allows).
Flies at up to 120 km/h with up to 100 kg (if Strength allows).
A cold flame in the palm (light, no heat, no frenzy); thrown, it burns as fire: soak difficulty 3, 1 aggravated a turn.
As Candle, but soak difficulty 4, 1 aggravated a turn.
As Candle, but soak difficulty 5, 2 aggravated a turn.
As Candle, but soak difficulty 7, 2 aggravated a turn.
As Candle, but soak difficulty 9, 3 aggravated a turn.
Speeds one mount or walker on the road.
Up to six mounts or one laden wagon.
Up to twelve mounts or four supply wagons.
Up to 24 mounts, eight supply wagons or one siege engine.
Up to 48 mounts, sixteen supply wagons or four siege engines.
Moves an object of up to half a kilogram at a distance.
Up to 10 kg; a held weapon can attack (first turn uses the activation successes, then Melee + Thaumaturgy, Strength = the path's dots).
Up to 100 kg; can lift and fly self or another at running speed (an unwilling target makes opposed Willpower each turn).
Up to 250 kg.
Up to 500 kg.
Fog or light wind (+1 to sight checks, ranges halved) or a small change of temperature.
Rain or snow (+2 to sight checks, ranges halved).
High wind (+2 to ranged attacks, ranges halved, Dexterity at 6 each turn to stay standing) or a larger change of temperature.
Rain and high winds together.
As Storm, and Perception + Occult calls lightning on a target: 10 dice lethal.
Aware of all that happens within 15 meters, which even Obfuscate cannot hide; own koldunic powers up to this level work anywhere in it. A scene a success; 1 Willpower more.
Aware of all that happens within 100 meters, which even Obfuscate cannot hide; own koldunic powers up to this level work anywhere in it. A scene a success; 1 Willpower more.
Aware of all that happens within half a kilometer, which even Obfuscate cannot hide; own koldunic powers up to this level work anywhere in it. A scene a success; 1 Willpower more.
Aware of all that happens within 1.5 kilometers, which even Obfuscate cannot hide; own koldunic powers up to this level work anywhere in it. A scene a success; 1 Willpower more.
Aware of all that happens within 8 kilometers, which even Obfuscate cannot hide; own koldunic powers up to this level work anywhere in it. A scene a success; 1 Willpower more.
Visions of the target's own damnation: each success takes a die from all the target's pools until a Road roll (difficulty 6, once a night) shakes it off. A Cainite who botches that roll frenzies.

Meeting the eyes and whispering a temptation stirs the target to act on a dark impulse, as strong as the successes. On a Cainite it costs a Willpower point; a Road roll at the infernalist's Willpower resists.
Takes on the look of someone the target loves: one success is a rough likeness, five a perfect one.
Plants the urge to a sin, for a turn, an hour, a night, a week or a month by successes. The target may spend Willpower and roll permanent Willpower (difficulty 6), needing more successes.
Slays a mortal and tears the shadow free as a near-invisible servant for the night: it spies, passes through matter and speaks mind to mind at any distance. It fades at dawn.
No roll: sees nearby spirits, demons and ghosts as if they stood in the flesh. While gazing, all the infernalist's difficulties rise by 1.
Reads what grieves the target most: one success shows whether they feel guilt, five shows their sins, enemies and failings.
Draws one specific memory from the target for each success.
Runestones carved from a new set of a person's bones show the likeliest future: the next moments, a week, a lunar month, a season or a year by successes. Truer for great events than for one person.
Where blood was shed in anger, raises a minor demon in the victim's likeness and wounds that hunts the killer for a day and a night per success.
A touch reopens an old wound: one health level per success, soaked as usual.
The target feels the penalties of one lost health level per success without losing them, even to Incapacitated. Supernatural targets soak with Willpower; healing with blood clears them.
Each success takes one of the target's senses, sight first, for the scene; a vampire spends a blood point to win each back. Or it numbs pain: wound penalties fall by the successes.
Vermin grow in the flesh for a day per success: each day one level from the flies and as many from the maggots as the days so far. Not soaked; blood heals it, but it runs its course.
Festering sores: one aggravated level per success that mortals cannot soak or heal. While they last, the target takes as many soakable levels each time they sleep.
Calls an insignificant demon (Attributes 4/3/2, Abilities 3/2/1, no Disciplines). Successes set how far it serves; a failure wastes the night, a botch makes it attack.
Calls a least demon (Attributes 5/4/3, Abilities 4/3/2, 2 points of Disciplines or investments). Successes set how far it serves; a failure wastes the night, a botch makes it attack.
Calls a lesser demon (Attributes 6/5/4, Abilities 5/4/3, 4 points). Successes set how far it serves; a failure wastes the night, a botch makes it attack.
Calls a minor demon (Attributes 7/6/5, Abilities 6/5/4, 6 points). Successes set how far it serves; a failure wastes the night, a botch makes it attack.
Calls a specific demon (a named demon who wants sacrifices and serves only its own ends). Successes set how far it serves; a failure wastes the night, a botch makes it attack.
A small mishap: each success cancels one success on the target's next roll.
A string of accidents for an hour per success: the target ignores the highest die of every roll.
A chant heard wherever the target flees: each success takes a die from their pools while the chanting goes on. On a group, each success costs one listener a die.
Set the difficulty to the target's Stamina. The target can have no children; a vampire can no longer Embrace. Only exorcism, high rituals or the caster's death lift it.

A resisted Willpower roll (difficulty 8) with the target; the loser is cursed for a year: +1 to all difficulties, Appearance 0 and a Minor Curse. A vampire holds it off by spending four more blood each day.
The night winds bring the words of anyone speaking in the open air within a mile; one success is enough.
Stirs vermin to harass: from gathering, to biting one target, an area, chosen targets, or everyone near. Those plagued add 2 to their difficulties.
No roll: drinks a beast's blood and takes its shape until dawn, with its claws or bite; 1 blood for a bird or mouse, 3 for a wolf, 5 or more for a bear. No other Disciplines while masked.
Set the difficulty to the target's Stamina. Spits a coughed-up blood point (Dexterity + Archery in a fight): one aggravated level per success. A botch is three aggravated levels to the strigmaga.
Each success costs a blood point and grows a barbed tentacle: Strength and Dexterity 5, Strength + 2 lethal, 4 health levels; more blood raises a trait by 1. That blood does not come back.
Rides the senses of the animals in range (20 yards to a mile by successes) and does nothing else. After, Wits + Empathy at 10 minus Road or keep their passions; a botch ends in frenzy.
Eye contact steers an animal's will: plain acts at one success, complex tasks at five. It breaks past a mile; a botch brings frenzy.
A touch: each success adds one to the victim's difficulty to resist frenzy. A botch frenzies the caster.
A touch marks the subject's soul for ten years; later Perception + Empathy (6) tells where they are.
Rides a seen target's senses while concentrating (2 less if willing). Successes set which Disciplines work through them: none, Auspex, then Presence, Dominate, Thaumaturgy.
Draws one secret from a seen subject; successes set how clear and how large, a word to a whole tale.
Hears every thought nearby; each success sorts out one clear thought. A botch leaves a derangement until the caster leaves.
Taken instead of a Celerity dot (or 30 XP later). Puts Celerity into a thrown missile: each dot is a level of damage that needs no roll.
Taken instead of a Celerity dot. In melee, Celerity dice cancel a defender's dodge successes for the scene.
Taken instead of a Celerity dot. Runs 5 feet up or 10 feet across per dot on walls or bad ground; over moving water, Dexterity + Athletics.
Moving illusions up to the caster's Willpower, a blood point for each after the first, lasting while the caster concentrates.
A blood point a duplicate of the caster for the scene; steering one is Wits + Subterfuge (6), pool split for more. A botch fades it.
A whole false world for one victim, a turn to a fortnight by successes. Willpower at the caster's pool notices; a Willpower point shatters it.
Touch or eye contact plants hellfire: at the next noon (a day later per success) the victim burns as in sunlight a turn per blood point, soaked only with Fortitude. A botch burns the caster.
Eye contact, resisted by Intelligence + Self-Control (6): the target's mind becomes a copy of the caster's, derangements too, a night to a year.
Words that plant a derangement and its trigger (1 harder if hidden in talk): one success, a year; two or more, for good.
Stops or starts one body function (heartbeat, breath, sight, hearing) for a turn per success; above 10 it cannot work. A vampire's heart does not matter.
With Murmur of the False Will on a crowd's most stubborn: each extra success carries the command to one more. If the first resists, none obey.
Works Dominate through a puppet ruler, who may never know; a roll for each new power used through them.
Taken instead of the next Fortitude dot. Struck by an object, roll Fortitude (7): equal to or more than the damage successes and the weapon shatters; otherwise soak as usual.
Taken instead of a Fortitude dot. A blood point per Fortitude dot given (up to the caster's own), drunk by the subject, for a turn to a chapter by successes.
Taken instead of a Fortitude dot. Stays awake by day (a turn to all day by successes) with pools up to Road + Willpower, or a blood point to wake at once.
A corpse a blood point rises for a turn per success: living Physicals, Mentals 1, one more health level, no wound penalties, gone at Incapacitated.
Feels any death within 50 yards, from the bare fact to every detail by successes; on the living (at their Willpower) it tells how near their death is.
A touch spreads a sickness to victims up to the caster's Willpower: each rolls Stamina (+Fortitude) at the caster's Stamina + Occult or dies within an hour; vampires fall to torpor.
An image of the caster a yard to 30 yards off draws every eye; other actions are 1 harder. Touching the world calls for contested Perception + Alertness.
Hides ten people per Stealth dot with no roll; shouting or a fight inside calls for Wits + Stealth. Leaving it, successes set how far, 10 to 2000 yards.
Seen as the one person the subject would tell anything; more successes, a better likeness.
Shadow wraps a victim: a mortal loses a blood point a turn, all at +3 difficulty; a Cainite fights fear (Courage 8). The caster takes back half the blood.
Wakes a subject's shadow for an hour per success: half their traits, Stealth 5, half the caster's Obtenebration. If it dies, the caster loses half their Willpower.
Up to three shadow servants from the caster's own shadow, a Willpower point and five blood points each, until dawn: no wound penalties, a cold touch that does aggravated harm.
Taken instead of a Potence dot. Brawls at a range in yards up to Potence, rolled as a ranged attack; the damage is Potence, rolled.
Taken instead of a Potence dot. Shapes a weapon by hand: a die of damage per two successes (up to 3) and it deals aggravated harm.
Taken instead of a Potence dot. A touch lands the full blow: Potence levels of damage; things cannot resist, the living soak as usual.
Floods a Cainite with mortal feelings: from nostalgia to -5 dice in ecstasy, or senseless at five. Harder by one per Road dot below 5.
Guilt drives one victim to their knees: a turn per success, whispering their sins; it even stills a frenzy.
Fires up troops: 2 to 20 mortals by successes (everyone in sight at five) ignore wound penalties to Crippled and pass every Courage roll.
Sinks into the earth and moves through it as through water, by day too; a hunt below is contested Wits + Athletics.
A man-wolf over eight feet tall in three turns: Physicals +3, Socials 1, Strength + 2 aggravated claws, a Hurt level more, keen senses.
Hurls a stake or other object out of the body.
After feeding on a mortal, each success makes one blood point count as two (the pool's limit still holds).
A touch locks blood points equal to the successes, for as many turns. Works on ghouls, not on mortals. Harder by the target's Fortitude.
A cut and a touch plant blood that turns to asps when called, within three nights: a health level a blood point, soaked only with Fortitude.
A touch makes the victim a python for a scene to a year, Intelligence 1. Back in human shape, Wits + Empathy (6) or a lasting fear of snakes.
A serpent-man in three turns: Strength and Stamina +2, Dexterity +3, Appearance 0, crushing tail, Strength + 2 aggravated bite, a soak die more. Two blood a night to keep.
Grafts dead parts onto one living host to make a guardian that lives an hour to a year by successes.
A touch turns body parts to blood, a blood point a success (target's Stamina 6 cancels one each). Head or torso kills a mortal; a vampire regrows each part with blood.
Fleshcrafts at range: the successes are the dice the caster may use on the Vicissitude roll.
Cows another creature's Beast into grudging obedience, 5 to 8 by its power; it obeys until the Laibon relaxes. A botch is Rotschreck.
Writes the name of an ancient beast; it comes within a scene, unbound, and must be appeased.
Takes a soul into the caster's own to heal it: a permanent Willpower point restores a Road dot. Difficulty 12 minus Road; not on Road 1 or the Via Diabolis.
Pain that goes on after the touch, a scene a success; a level of harm a blood point if wished, and frenzy (Willpower 6) once past the target's Willpower.
After Purification, thrusts the evil spirit into a thing, beast or person in reach; a living host may cost a Road roll.
Hardens a thing for a turn per success: a shield or door resists one more health level per success; a weapon gains a die of damage per two successes.
Each success turns a blood point's worth of liquid (about two pints) solid, at its own heat; spilled blood or boiling oil alike. Solid blood cannot be drunk.
Melts three pounds of metal, wood or stone a success: a coin, an arrow, a knife, a sword, a shield. It sets again as a useless lump.
A cubic foot of air a success turns to ice around a foe, a prison that holds until it ends.
Three pounds of solid a success turn to vapor. When it sets again, those nearby roll Dexterity + Athletics (6) or take a level; a botch traps them, aggravated.
A small shock by touch or through metal or water: two dice of damage. Successes set the gathering time: a minute at one, two turns at three, at once at five.
Lightning wreathes the arm and lights a room; a touch does four dice of damage.
The whole body sheathed in sparks: six dice of damage by touch or through a conductor.
A sheath of lightning that does eight dice of damage to what it touches.
A blinding aura: ten dice of damage by touch, and all who look at the caster lose a die and cannot Dominate them.

powers.d: Thaumaturgy: Prey on the Soul's Fear
powers.e: Fear roots a seen victim: each success takes a die from their pools; at none left they cannot act.

powers.d: Thaumaturgy: Prey on the Soul's Fear
powers.e: One to ten people by successes flee the caster's gaze unless their Courage (at the caster's Willpower) beats the successes.

powers.d: Thaumaturgy: Prey on the Soul's Fear
powers.e: A vision of damnation: the victim cowers for a turn to a night by successes, acting only with Courage (7) above the successes.

powers.d: Thaumaturgy: Prey on the Soul's Fear
powers.e: Shows the victim their deepest dread; more successes, deeper and longer, at five enough to break their mind.

powers.d: Thaumaturgy: Prey on the Soul's Fear
powers.e: Horrors seen by two to twenty people by successes, from halting to fainting; at five, Courage (8) or lose a permanent Willpower point.
A blood sigil on a door: it opens only to Strength of twice the successes, and the caster knows when it does.
A glyph to see and hear through for a day per success, one at a time, at +2 difficulty while watching.
Runes on a thing deal an aggravated level per success to anyone but the caster who touches it (Fortitude soaks), until sunlight or ruin.
As Glyph of Scrying (Willpower 7), but the caster may speak and send other Thaumaturgy through it, a day off for each.
A glyph at a building's exact centre seals every door, window and breach until dawn (Willpower 8); they can still be broken.
